composition: Pine peninsula splitting the old port · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the old-port quay, Bourtzi is a pine-covered peninsula between the fishing boats and the newer harbor, with a cream neoclassical school among the trees and only low fragments of the Venetian wall. It is not an offshore castle islet. The sky is clear, about 5 percent cloud, about 19.6°C, with wind near 28 km/h, so the open water is lightly choppy. The sun is low in the east-southeast.
